subject.title: RFC: OpenClaw Mobile App Design Directions

question: Should this PR become the maintainer-sponsored venue for collecting OpenClaw mobile app design directions before any accepted implementation work?
rationale: The diff is mechanically small, but accepting or merging it chooses an RFC venue, sponsorship, and mobile product-direction process that automation cannot decide from source evidence alone.

options.title: Follow the RFC lifecycle first
options.body: Link the required maintainer-discussion thread, confirm the sponsor/authorship, and keep the RFC unmerged while it remains draft.

options.title: Keep collecting comments
options.body: Leave the PR open as a draft discussion venue while contributors add separate design-direction comments before maintainers choose next steps.

options.title: Close if unsponsored
options.body: If maintainers do not want this PR to be the mobile design venue, close it and point contributors to the chosen discussion location.

recommendation.title: Follow the RFC lifecycle first
recommendation.body: Link the required maintainer-discussion thread, confirm the sponsor/authorship, and keep the RFC unmerged while it remains draft.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the RFC lifecycle rules that determine what evidence is needed before this draft RFC can merge.
